title: born blue
overview: PLEASE NOTE: June 2027 is not a confirmed date. It is our target completion date and may change.  Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine. Unreal Engine is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.  Set in Mount Gambier, South Australia, the film follows Lumy, a young girl who witnesses her father’s sacrifice at the edge of the mysterious Blue Lake. Growing up with unhealed trauma and an unexplainable power tied to the water itself, Lumy retreats into science while being quietly hunted by forces she doesn’t fully understand.  Years later, she forms a deep connection with a broken but kindred soul, Ashton. Together, they become scientists and uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the lake one that links Lumy’s existence to a phenomenon capable of reshaping reality. As the past resurfaces and the hunters return, Lumy must confront what her father died to protect. Born In Blue is a story of grief, survival, inheritance, and the cost of love.

title: The Quiet Hour
overview: "The Quiet Hour" is a gripping, intimate drama set over the course of one relentless night shift in an NHS hospital, where overworked nurse Riya battles exhaustion, guilt, and the ghosts of past mistakes while caring for her patients. As she juggles a collapsing system, an understaffed ward, and a stream of emergencies—from dying patients to Fred, a combative amputee, and a medical error that nearly costs a life—her professional composure begins to fracture. Haunted by the memory of a young girl she couldn’t save and the growing distance from her teenage daughter, Riya’s night spirals into a raw reckoning with compassion, burnout, and the quiet heroism that holds the health service together.

title: Bluebird
overview: Noah leaves London behind for the industrial banks of the Thames, where they’re invited into a state of in-between, as the city fades away and the river turns to sea.  Searching for direction on the quiet banks, they encounter a dancer, whose movement gives form to Noah’s unspoken thoughts. Stirred by the moment, they’re then met with a mysterious figure who reawakens their sense of purpose and hope. Noah begins to mirror the shifting landscape, learning to find comfort in flux.  A meditative, voiceover-driven film written by Zohrab Yoncali, based on the PhD research of artist Nic Farr.

title: War of the Worlds
overview: Collage film built upon the audio of The War of the Worlds, directed and narrated by Orson Welles. Originally broadcast in October 1938 as a Halloween prank, the program famously triggered mass panic across the United States, as its format—presented as a series of live news bulletins—proved uncannily convincing. Absorbing the visual language of the contemporary media environment, W:A:R:O:F:T:H:E:W:O:R:L:D:S constructs a peculiar media-archaeological artifact. AI-generated videos, drone footage, feature films, video games, and online fragments converge with the original radio broadcast, creating a layered and unstable field of perception.

title: Krew

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

overview: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

Mercy, a starlet who lent her likeness to the programme, arrives to terminate her contract. Instead, the process begins to collapse the distance between them, and what was designed as a clear division becomes porous and unstable.

title: the is of it
overview: “There is much to say that I don’t know how to say. The words are lacking. But I refuse to invent new ones: those that already exist must say what can be said and what is forbidden. Beyond thought there are no words: it is itself. My painting has no words: it is beyond thought. In this land of the is-itself I am pure crystalline ecstasy. It is itself. I am myself. You are yourself.” - Clarice Lispector

overview: In rainy, nocturnal London, photographer Miles obsessively captures unforgiving, morbid portraits of oblivious strangers. When not selling them, he shares them online as 'Rain Catcher'. As her gaze closes in, his world fractures—his work is sabotaged, his name defamed, his loved ones endangered. Consumed by paranoia, he spirals into a dark, delirious obsession to uncover the truth behind her motives. Based on the 2018 short film of the same name.

overview: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.

title: Switch Off
overview: When a seemingly dead phone comes back to life, it begins documenting a man’s reality and his future. As the images turn fatal, he finds himself trapped in a moment he can’t escape.

title: Echoed Blood
overview: Engaged in online forums and exploration, three friends investigate a desolate forest for proof of a vampiric creature.

title: Dragon Lizard Lord vs. Gorilla Monkey King
original_title: Dragon Lizard Lord vs. Gorilla Monkey King
overview: Typhon invades America. Zeus hits Miami and storms inland to crush Washington DC and clash with the mighty Dragon Lizard Lord in the ultimate battle of the big boys. In a panicked stricken madness, the humans unleash giant Robots.

title: Moodswing Whiskey
overview: A successful but embattled Black entrepreneur, Leo Marks, turns to violence against perceived traitors in his media company as his control slips, culminating in a tragic showdown that explores themes of power, betrayal, and legacy.

title: Christmas on the North Pole Express
original_title: Christmas on the North Pole Express
overview: A woman named Cassidy rides a train to her small, home town, and explores her past, present, and future in different cars in the train.

title: NEOT: The Movie
overview: The long-awaited finale to NEOT! Will the cast finally make a funny joke? Will Mappy return again? And will the sloppily constructed lore finally coalesce into something somewhat coherent? There's only one way to find out!

title: Humans Are Shapes
overview: After having possessed the bodies of two trans sisters, two aliens make a fatal choice in order to obey human codes against taboo, all in pursuit of love and security.

title: Polymer
overview: A cuck smokes a cigarette backwards while a failed rapper reminisces on his downfall. They come to realize a startling existential truth.

title: Heathen
overview: A young priest's faith is tested when his mentor returns from a mystical encounter.

title: Freddy’s Back
overview: “FREDDY’S BACK" stars Michael Leavy (Terrifier, STREAM) as 'Freddy Krueger' alongside Allison Pittel (Screamboat) as 'Natalie', in an original nightmare sequence that puts Leavy beneath the fedora and into full Freddy prosthetics for the first time.
